If the authoritative environment is unavailable but useful work can still be carried out elsewhere, the agent must clearly distinguish preparatory work from authoritative implementation and must not falsely claim that the authoritative environment was modified.

Permanent purge is a separate privileged operation, requires explicit confirmation and 2FA for protected project policies, and is blocked while retained objects are referenced by active descendants, releases, change requests, audit requirements or recovery points. Purge records what was removed and what immutable audit evidence remains.
